answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with path-linked relics. New keys must finish a rotating unpaid micro-task chain at independent endpoints; each step seals a relic whose onyx-hash binds the prior proof. Peers wander that chain and slash keys whose paths collide or share operator fingerprints. A farm needs distinct live endpoints for every fake identity and weeks of honest answering—so N clones cost N real infrastructure paths, not N free keys.
